svg.title: Exercise 4.4.3 midband equivalent
svg.desc: Gate through 2 megaohms and 75 kiloohms in series to ground. Source through 2 kiloohms to ground. Drain through 10 kiloohms to ground. Controlled current source gm times vgs from drain to source. Output is the drain voltage.
